title: Final velocity expression
description: Essential: Correctly states the relativistic expression for final velocity v as a function of accelerating voltage V, proton mass, and fundamental constants.

title: First-order deviation approximation
description: Important: Derives or states the first-order approximation for Δ = (c-v)/c as ½(m_ec²/(m_ec²+Ve))² for the electron case.

title: Magnetic field derivation
description: Essential: Derives the expression B = 2πE/(e c L) from balancing Lorentz and centripetal forces, using v≈c and relativistic energy.

title: Total radiated power calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates total radiated power using the Larmor formula, approximating γ = E/(m_pc²) and using given parameters.

title: Acceleration time calculation
description: Important: Calculates time T for proton acceleration through the linac using relativistic dynamics and the given homogeneous field.

title: Mass from ToF parameters
description: Essential: Expresses particle mass m in terms of momentum p, flight length l, and flight time t, assuming v≈c, resulting in m = (p/(lc))√(t²c² - l²).

title: ToF detector minimal length
description: Essential: Calculates the minimal length l for pion/kaon separation using Δt > 3*(150 ps) and relativistic time-of-flight expressions.

title: Significant figures and units
description: Pitfall: Fails to report final numerical answers with correct significant figures or consistent SI units (e.g., T in tesla, l in meters).

title: Non-relativistic approximation
description: Pitfall: Uses non-relativistic formulas (e.g., v=√(2Ve/m)) where relativistic expressions are required, especially for high energies.

title: Approximation justification
description: Optional: Explicitly justifies approximations used (e.g., v≈c, γ>>1) where their effect is smaller than the given precision.
